basic_info.description: Detached and fully reimagined Marina‑style home in sunny Crocker Amazon! Offering 4 bedrooms and 3 baths across a flexible ~2,400 sq ft layout, this home combines San Francisco charm with modern updates. Features include European oak flooring, open‑concept kitchen with waterfall island, spa‑like primary suite, LED‑lit ceilings, and a sunny flat backyard. The lower level provides permitted space with separate entrance  perfect for multi‑gen living or rental income. Located near Crocker Amazon Park, McLaren Park, Mission Safeway, City College, Geneva bus lines, Balboa BART, and I‑280, this vibrant neighborhood offers more space and value without leaving the city.
